text:
Liam (MedPay): Hi team — for the POC we need SOC 2 Type II artifacts, ISO 27001 cert copy, and a signed pen-test attestation letter. Legal needs this before we finalise SOW next Friday. Also we need staging IPs and a way to push evidence (SFTP or presigned S3). Can you confirm what you can provide and ETA? Thanks.

Maya (Sales): On it. cc @Priya for solutioning and @Omar for security. What's the exact deadline? Next Friday works?

Liam (MedPay): Yes EOD next Friday (2024-06-07). Also need to know if dedicated tenancy affects timeline/pricing.

Priya (Solutions): We can assemble a proof pack. Need to know: (a) do you need raw logs or just audit artifacts (policies/controls), (b) is vendor pen-test letter acceptable (we have a standard attestation) or they need our third-party report? For evidence transfer we can provide presigned S3 or SFTP with one-time creds.

Omar (Security): Quick note — our standard pen-test attestation is a signed letter confirming we run regular pentests. We don't share full third-party reports unless NDA; customers typically get attestation + high level vuln summary. If they require full report we need to check legal/3P consent.

Raj (Eng): For staging: we can open a CIDR for MedPay and create short-lived staging keys. Example for presigned S3 upload (we'll provide script):
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://rwd-evidence/medpay/2024-06-01.zip --expires-in 3600
```
Or SFTP with one-time user + chroot. Which do you prefer?

Priya (Solutions): Liam — prefer SFTP due to internal policy. If so, we can provision an SFTP account scoped to a single folder and rotate creds. Also can provide network diagram, control mapping (SOC2 control ids -> Redwood artifacts), KMS separation notes.

Omar (Security): Heads-up — we'll redact any customer PII from logs prior to upload. For SOC2 evidence we'll include: SOC2 report cover, control narratives, config screenshots, access lists, change logs. ISO artefacts: certificate, scope doc, statement of applicability.

Maya (Sales): Pricing note — Dedicated POC (isolated infra) has a one-time setup and monthly reserved estimate. For a short POC we usually bill a day-rate for reserved nodes + data transfer. I can send an estimate by EOD.

Liam (MedPay): SFTP is fine. Also can we get a redlined pen-test attestation template to run by our security team?

Priya (Solutions): Yes — I'll drop our attestation template and a suggested redline. Also including a checklist: network CIDR, SFTP username, desired retention, encryption-at-rest confirmation, and SLA for evidence delivery.

Raj (Eng): Proposing staging CIDR: 52.101.200.0/24 (can narrow to IPs). We'll create temporary creds that expire after 7 days. If you need longer we can extend.

Omar (Security): Also need confirmation on whether MedPay wants vulnerability scan artifacts (e.g., auth token for Netsparker/Qualys). If yes, scans are red-team/3P artifacts and require auth release.

Liam (MedPay): We only need the attestation + SOC2/ISO cert + network diagram for legal. No full scan. Thanks for the CIDR — 52.101.200.0/24 is fine. ETA for pack?

Priya (Solutions): We can assemble the pack and SFTP creds by Tue EOD (three business days). Pen-test attestation template dropping in thread in 30m.

Maya (Sales): I'll follow up with pricing estimate and SOW note. :thumbsup:

Liam (MedPay): Great — appreciate it. I'll loop Legal to expect the pack Tues. Thanks!
